rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.0025, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=adam, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-9 OPTIMIZER pivot. Lambda peak located at 2.5e-3 (iter-8 hr=0.36286 best; 2e-3->0.3552, 3e-3->0.3597). Earlier convergence logs showed the TV term still descending at iter-1000 under plain GD (data term converged) => the TV minimum may be under-converged by GD. ONE knob: tv_optimizer gd->adam (keep lambda=2.5e-3, 1000 iters, lr=0.01, decay=0.01, fbp). HYPOTHESIS: Adam's adaptive per-parameter steps reach a deeper TV minimum than plain GD in 1000 iters so hr rises past 0.36286; if Adam at lr=0.01 overshoots/destabilizes the data term (hr collapses) GD is required and I revert then tune lr/decay. (Note: manhart's adam@lr=0.01 collapsed hr->0 on the same TV core — this is a genuine independent test on plain TV.) Budget: ~950s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
